title: Credit Control Parameters for Physician Client Accounts
content:
The figures below set the credit position of every class of Physician Client Accounts: the organization's credit limit, the late fee and its grace period, the point at which an account goes on credit hold, when an account on hold becomes eligible for closure, what release from a hold requires, and the written notice an organization gives to end its client agreement.

## Parameter table

| Account class | Credit limit (organization, USD) | Late fee (percent of the past-due amount) | Late-fee grace (calendar days after the due date) | Credit hold at (calendar days past due) | Closure eligible after (calendar days on credit hold) | Release needs every past-due amount paid | Termination notice (calendar days, written) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 5000.00 | 1.5 | 15 | 60 | 90 | Yes | 30 |
| Group Practice Client Account | 15000.00 | 1.5 | 15 | 60 | 90 | Yes | 30 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 50000.00 | 1.5 | 15 | 60 | 120 | Yes | 60 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 20000.00 | 1.0 | 30 | 90 | 120 | Yes | 60 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 100000.00 | 1.0 | 15 | 75 | 120 | Yes | 90 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 10000.00 | 1.5 | 15 | 45 | 90 | Yes | 30 |

## What each figure means

- **Credit limit**: the maximum client balance across the organization's accounts before a credit hold; it is measured for the organization, not for one location.
- **Late fee**: a percentage of the past-due amount, assessed once per client invoice period that is still unpaid when the late-fee grace has run after its due date.
- **Credit hold at**: the number of calendar days past due at which the account goes on credit hold.
- **Closure eligible after**: the number of calendar days on credit hold after which the laboratory may close the account.
- **Release needs every past-due amount paid**: Yes in every class.
- **Termination notice**: the calendar days of written notice the organization gives to end the agreement.

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

| Past-due amount | Late fee at 1.5 percent | Late fee at 1.0 percent |
|---|---|---|
| USD 2000.00 | USD 30.00 | USD 20.00 |
| USD 640.00 | USD 9.60 | USD 6.40 |

The Federally Qualified Health Center Account is the only class with a 30-day late-fee grace and a 90-day credit-hold point; the Occupational Health Employer Account reaches credit hold earliest, at 45 calendar days past due.
